title: California's 34th Congressional District General Election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for California's 34th Congressional District pits seven-term Democratic incumbent Jimmy Gomez against Democratic challenger Angela Gonzales-Torres, a progressive community advocate endorsed by Justice Democrats. The district, which includes downtown Los Angeles, Boyle Heights, East Los Angeles, and Highland Park, is heavily Democratic (Cook Partisan Voting Index: D+28) and rated 'Solidly Democratic' by the Cook Political Report. The race reflects a progressive-versus-establishment dynamic within the Democratic Party, with Gomez emphasizing his seniority and committee positions (Ways and Means) while Gonzales-Torres calls for a more aggressive progressive agenda, including Medicare for All and abolishing ICE.
polling_note: No public general election polls were found for this race as of mid-June 2026. The Cook Political Report rates the district as Solidly Democratic.

candidates.name: Jimmy Gomez
candidates.summary: Jimmy Gomez has represented California's 34th Congressional District since 2017. A former labor organizer and California State Assemblymember, he serves on the House Ways and Means Committee and is a founding member of the Medicare for All Caucus and the Congressional Progressive Caucus. Gomez emphasizes his progressive legislative record, including work on renters' rights, paid family leave, and climate change legislation.

candidates.name: Angela Gonzales-Torres
candidates.summary: Angela Gonzales-Torres is a community advocate and progressive challenger endorsed by Justice Democrats. A lifelong resident of Highland Park, she has served as President of the Historic Highland Park Neighborhood Council and as an academic counselor at Pasadena City College's CORE program, supporting formerly incarcerated students. Her campaign focuses on getting corporate money out of politics, Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and ending U.S. funding for weapons used in foreign wars.

forecast.rationale: California's 34th Congressional District has a Cook PVI of D+28 and is rated 'Solidly Democratic' by the Cook Political Report. Both general-election candidates are Democrats — seven-term incumbent Jimmy Gomez faces progressive challenger Angela Gonzales-Torres (endorsed by Justice Democrats). No public general-election polls are available. At the party level, a Democratic win is certain (100%), as there is no Republican or third-party candidate on the ballot. At the candidate level, incumbent Jimmy Gomez holds advantages in seniority, name recognition, institutional support, and committee position (Ways and Means), though Gonzales-Torres has an organized progressive campaign. The absence of direct candidate-level polling limits precision, but the district's fundamentals and incumbency favor Gomez.
